annotations.title: China SAFEA 180-Day Police Certificate Expiration Radar

description: Measure elapsed calendar days since police check issuance, deduct DHL courier and SAFEA bureau review buffers, and classify net safe filing windows into safe, warning, critical, or expired.

asOfDate.description: Optional reference date in YYYY-MM-DD format to evaluate deadline status against (defaults to current UTC date).

issueDate.description: Original print/issuance date printed on the police background check in YYYY-MM-DD format.

safeaReviewBufferDays.description: Estimated days needed for sponsoring Chinese HR and SAFEA bureau preliminary acceptance (defaults to 15).

shippingBufferDays.description: Estimated calendar days for international DHL/FedEx transit and domestic translation (defaults to 10).
